message: The other day, as I was rummaging through my pantry, I stumbled upon a can of soup I forgot I had. I realized that for once, I was actually prepared for the impending storm. It felt quite nice to be the one with a stocked-up supply instead of running around like a headless chicken at the last minute. Who knew a little foresight could feel so satisfying? Now, if only I could remember where I hid the flashlight... 🕯️
